event.label_en: Upstream glacier/ice-rock collapse signal (USGS event type: landslide)
event.location_note: USGS locations for landslide seismic sources are approximate. The signal is 10.3 km from the nearest mapped Lende Khola point; the flood path bridges this with a straight-line leg standing in for an unmapped tributary.

public_feed.note: below the USGS M5 threshold for its 20-minute release target outside the US

speed_kmh.method: constant speed; Rasuwa Gadhi distance / (09:15 or 09:00 entry - 08:37:10 upstream signal)

sensitivity.note: *_no_offset fields assume the flood starts at the Lende Khola, not at the upstream signal. This is the largest uncertainty in downstream arrival windows.

calibration_points.name: Nepal border entry (Rasuwa Gadhi)
calibration_points.note: used to calibrate speed_kmh, so not an independent check
calibration_points.source: Borderlens 2026-08-26 ('around 9 a.m.'); Nepal Red Cross Society situation update 2026-08-26 ('approximately 9:15 AM')

properties.name: Lende Khola - Bhote Koshi - Trishuli
properties.first_segment: straight-line leg from the upstream signal to the Lende Khola (approximation)
